title.rendered: 99 Nights in the Forest Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest 99 Nights in the Forest Codes on September 03, 2026

Surviving in 99 Nights in the Forest is not easy. One mistake in the dark and you are surrounded by cultists, trapped by wolves, or chased back to camp by the Deer. Resources are limited, nights grow harder, and the wrong Class can slow your progress. That is why 99 Nights in the Forest codes are important. They give you free Gems, and Gems directly improve your chances of survival.

Below you will find all active codes, how to redeem them correctly, including the hidden chat method, and practical tips to earn more Gems while pushing toward Night 99.

Active 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

  • forestwakesup26: 15x Diamonds, 1x Apple Tree Flame, 1x Frog Flame, and 1x Fishing Flame (NEW)

Expired 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

AFTERPARTY, HAPPYHALLOWEEN, YAY FISHING

How to Redeem 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

There are two different ways to redeem codes in this game. Most players only know about one.

Standard Lobby Method

Most codes must be redeemed in the lobby before starting a match.

  1. Launch 99 Nights in the Forest on Roblox.
  2. Stay in the matchmaking lobby.
  3. Click the Gems or diamond icon in the lower left corner, or speak to the currency NPC.
  4. Click the blue Codes button in the bottom right.
  5. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  6. Press Submit.

If the code is active, your Gems, sometimes labeled as Diamonds in the interface, will be added instantly.

Special Chat Method for “yay fishing”

The yay fishing code does not work in the Codes menu. It must be entered in chat while fishing.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Start a solo or multiplayer lobby.
  2. Upgrade your Campfire to Level 2.
  3. Locate the Fishing Shack.
  4. Pick up the Old Rod.
  5. Use the rod at any fishing hole.
  6. While actively fishing, press “/” to open chat.
  7. Type yay fishing and press Enter.

If done correctly, you will receive 2 Gems immediately. It is a small reward, but Gems are not easy to earn, so every bonus matters.

What Are Gems Used For?

Gems are the main premium currency in 99 Nights in the Forest. They are not cosmetic rewards. They affect gameplay and progression.

You can spend Gems to:

  • Unlock new Classes
  • Reroll Talents
  • Purchase options from the Daily Class Shop

Classes play a major role in survival. Some are better suited for solo players, while others are designed for coordinated teams. If you struggle in the later nights, upgrading your Class often makes the biggest difference.

How to Earn More Gems Without Codes

Codes provide a helpful boost, but long term progress depends on survival and smart strategy.

Here are the main ways to earn more Gems:

  • Survive more nights in a single run. The longer you last, the more Gems you earn.
  • Rescue Missing Kids to increase your Day Multiplier.
  • Build Beds early to speed up day progression.
  • Participate in Admin Abuse events, which typically happen before or during Saturday updates.
  • Purchase the Survival Kit for 299 Robux, which includes 20 Gems and two playable Classes.

The deeper your run goes, the better the rewards. At the same time, enemy difficulty increases rapidly.

Why Your Code Is Not Working

If a code fails to redeem, check the following:

  • The code may have expired.
  • You may not be in the lobby for standard redemption.
  • There could be a spelling error.
  • Servers may not have refreshed after an update.
  • You may not have completed the required steps for special codes, such as fishing.

Copy and paste codes whenever possible to avoid typing mistakes.

How to Get More 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

New codes usually appear during major updates, seasonal events, or special milestones. Since the game does not release codes frequently, staying informed gives you an advantage.

Here are the best ways to find new codes early:

  • Join the official 99 Nights in the Forest Discord server for update announcements.
  • Follow the developers on X for event news and patch updates.
  • Check the game’s Roblox community page for announcements.
  • Revisit this guide regularly for verified working codes.

Codes often drop around content updates, balance changes, or holiday events. If a big update goes live, it is always worth checking for new rewards.

What Is 99 Nights in the Forest?

99 Nights in the Forest is a Roblox survival horror game where players must survive 99 increasingly dangerous nights in a haunted forest. Your mission is to locate Missing Kids while crafting tools, gathering supplies, and defending against hostile creatures, including the Deer and the Cultist King.

The game blends survival mechanics with horror tension. You can play solo or team up with others. Coordinated teams generally survive longer, especially in the late game.

Final Thoughts

Free codes in 99 Nights in the Forest are limited, which makes each one valuable. Right now, afterparty, happyhalloween, and the special yay fishing method are the available ways to earn free rewards.

Redeem them early, invest your Gems wisely, build your multipliers quickly, and never let your campfire burn out. If you make it past Night 50, you are already ahead of most players.

Related articles worth reading

  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Jujutsu Legacy Codes
  • Mojave Valley Codes

title.rendered: Roblox Knockout Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Knockout Codes on September 03, 2026

Knockout throws you onto a shrinking sheet of ice with nothing but a direction and a power slider. You lock in your move without seeing anyone else’s choice. Then the timer ends. Every penguin launches at once. Collisions decide who survives and who disappears into the water.

Because matches are fast and skill-based, progression mostly comes from cosmetics. Ice lets you unlock skins. Spins give you prize wheel rewards. Limited-time events add special currencies like Hearts. Instead of grinding match after match, you can use Roblox Knockout codes to claim these rewards instantly.

Below is the complete and updated list of all working Knockout codes.

All Working Roblox Knockout Codes

  • EMPERORRETURNS: 500 Ice (NEW)
  • THANKSFORPLAYING: 3 Spins (NEW)

Ice is the main in-game currency used to unlock cosmetic skins. Spins let you try your luck on the prize wheel. Hearts are limited-time event rewards. Skins are purely cosmetic, meaning they do not give you any gameplay advantage, but they absolutely make you look experienced.

Codes are case-sensitive, so enter them exactly as shown.

Looking for working game codes? Find the latest Solo Hunters codes, Horse Life codes, and BLR Legacy codes with free in-game rewards.

Expired Knockout Codes

100K, ADMINABUSE, BEMMY, BOOGIE, BUNDUN, CIRCUSEVENT, COLD, CRABRAVE, DELAY, DISCO, DOOMSDAY, FOLTYNADMINABUSE, HAPPYEASTER, HOTPOTATOMODE, LANARAE, LAVA, LIKES, LOVE, LUNAR, MAPS, POOLMAP, PUNCHMONKEY, RUSSO, SOCIALHUB, SORRY, SORRYQUESTS, SORRYVALENTINES, SPRING, STEAK, STPATRICKS, TEAMS, TEMPLETILES, THANKS, VALENTINES, VINDOOLY

How to Redeem Knockout Codes

Redeeming codes in Knockout only takes a few seconds. Here is what you need to do:

  1. Launch Knockout in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings (cog icon) in the bottom corner of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code in the Enter Code Here text box.
  4. Press Redeem.

If the code is valid, you will receive your rewards instantly.

To avoid typos, copy and paste the code directly. Even a small extra space can cause an error.

Why Are My Knockout Codes Not Working?

If your code does not work, here are the most common reasons:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed it incorrectly.
  • You added extra spaces.
  • Your server is bugged after a recent update.

If you suspect a server issue, try rejoining a new server. Always double-check your spelling, as codes are case-sensitive.

Do Skins Give an Advantage?

No. Skins in Knockout are purely cosmetic. They do not increase strength, speed, or knockback power. The game is fully skill-based. Skins simply indicate that you have played long enough to unlock them. They help you look intimidating when you push someone into the icy void.

How to Get More Roblox Knockout Codes

  • Join the braxworks Roblox group for updates.
  • Bookmark this page and check back regularly.

We update this list whenever new codes drop, so saving this page ensures you never miss free rewards.

Use these free codes to unlock new skins, spin rewards, and customize your penguin. Then step back onto the ice, read your opponents carefully, and aim with confidence. Only one penguin survives each round. Make sure it is yours.

title.rendered: Roblox You VS Homer Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest You vs Homer Codes on September 03, 2026

You VS Homer is one of the most chaotic hide-and-seek experiences on Roblox right now. Most players spawn as Bart and try to survive, while one player becomes Homer and hunts everyone down. Winning feels good, but for many players, the real progression happens in the shop.

Skins are the main reward loop in this game. Since earning currency takes time, promo codes are the fastest way to grab free cosmetics without extra grinding. Below are the only working You VS Homer codes.

All Working You VS Homer Codes

  • BUNNYEGGS2026: 250 Eggs (NEW)
  • LEEEEEPROCHAUN: 300 Coins (NEW)
  • FREEQUIDZ: 500 Coins

Quidz is the main in-game currency. You use it to buy Bart and Homer skins from the shop. Some skins are expensive, so free Quidz helps you unlock cosmetics faster.

Candy Hearts is a limited-time Valentine’s event currency. It is used for special event skins such as Cupid Bart and Valentine’s Lisa. Since this currency is event-based, any code that gives Candy Hearts may expire once the Valentine’s event ends. It is smart to redeem it as soon as possible.

For more free rewards, check out our updated BLR Legacy codes, Roblox Deep codes, and Solo Hunters codes lists for the latest working codes.

Expired You vs Homer Codes

FREEHEARTZ, NO EXPIRED CODES YET, SORRY, SORRYBUTAWESOME

How to Redeem You VS Homer Codes

Redeeming codes in You VS Homer takes less than a minute. Just follow these steps carefully.

  1. Launch You VS Homer on Roblox and wait until you load into the main lobby.
  2. Look at the bottom-left corner of the screen.
  3. Click the purple coupon or tag icon next to the camera button.
  4. Enter one of the working codes exactly as shown above.
  5. Click the purple arrow or press Enter.

If the code is valid, you will see a confirmation message on screen. Your Quidz or Candy Hearts balance will update instantly.

You VS Homer Code Not Working? Troubleshooting Guide

If your code is not working, the problem is usually small and easy to fix. Check the points below before assuming the code has expired.

  • Typing mistake: Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code. Even one incorrect letter will trigger an error. The safest method is to copy and paste the code exactly as shown.
  • Already redeemed: Roblox codes can only be used once per account. If you have claimed it before, it will not work again.
  • Recent update: If the game just received an update, the servers may need a short moment to refresh. Wait a minute and try again.
  • Event-based expiry: Some codes are tied to limited-time events. Candy Hearts, for example, are part of the Valentine’s event. Once the event ends, related codes may stop working without notice.

If none of the above fixes the issue, the code has most likely expired.

What Is You VS Homer?

You VS Homer is an asymmetrical hide-and-seek horror game on Roblox. At the start of each round, players are randomly assigned a role.

Most players spawn as Bart. As Bart, your goal is simple but stressful. You have 30 seconds to find a hiding spot before Homer spawns. You can hide in dumpsters, climb buildings, squeeze into tight corners, or keep moving. If you survive for 175 seconds, the Barts win.

One or more players become Homer. As Homer, your job is to hunt down every Bart before time runs out. You move fast, you check common hiding spots, and you listen for movement or taunts. If you catch every Bart before the timer ends, Homer wins.

The game mixes retro Roblox chaos with Simpsons-inspired humor. It feels silly at first, but when the timer is low and footsteps get closer, it becomes intense very quickly.

What Can You Buy With Quidz and Candy Hearts?

Currency in You VS Homer is purely cosmetic. It will not make you run faster or survive longer. But it does let you stand out.

With Quidz, you can buy various Bart and Homer skins from the shop. Some are simple variants, while others are more creative and themed.

With Candy Hearts, you can unlock limited-time Valentine’s skins. These are seasonal, which means they may not return once the event ends. If you care about collecting rare cosmetics, redeeming FREEHEARTZ is important.

How to Get More You VS Homer Codes

New codes usually appear during updates, special events, or milestones.

Developers often share codes through their official X account and the HOMER FANCLUB Discord server. However, codes may be posted without notifications, which makes them easy to miss.

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update it whenever new codes are released, so you do not miss free rewards. Codes do not last forever, and early redemption is always safer.

Final Thoughts

That’s all for our Roblox You VS Homer Codes list. We’ll keep checking for new codes and update this page whenever fresh rewards are released. Since Roblox codes can expire without warning, make sure to redeem them as soon as possible. If any code is not working, try restarting the game and entering it again exactly as shown.

  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Jujutsu Legacy Codes
  • Mojave Valley Codes
  • Roblox Knockout Codes

title.rendered: Solo Hunters Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Solo Hunters Codes on September 03, 2026

Dungeon runs in Solo Hunters can feel brutal when your build is not ready. One wrong stat decision or weak class choice can make bosses feel impossible. That is exactly why Solo Hunters codes matter. They give you free Gems, Class Rerolls, and Stat Resets so you can fix mistakes, experiment with builds, and grow stronger without wasting hours.

This guide includes all active Solo Hunters codes, expired codes, step-by-step redemption instructions, and clear answers to common questions. Everything is updated and explained in simple terms.

All Working Solo Hunters Codes

  • CASTLERUN: 5 Demon Castle Tickets (NEW)
  • BLESSINGS: 300 Blessing Shards and 300 Gems (NEW)
  • WAVEHUNTER: 3 Stat Crystals (NEW)
  • WHITEFLAME: 5 White Cinders and 3 Cinder Marks (NEW)
  • THANKYOU12: 400 Gems (NEW)
  • HUNDREDFLAMES: 8 Flame Souls, 8 Flame Quartzs, and 5 Sun Fragments (NEW)
  • UPDATE12: 2 Legendary Scrolls (NEW)
  • LUCKYSPIN: Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • SORRYFORSHUTDOWN: 25 Cinder Marks and 40 Soul Embers (NEW)
  • 2026 Release Schedule
  • Genshin Impact Odette Build
  • Genshin Impact Cryo Traveler
  • Pokopia Bubbly Basin
  • Anime Expeditions Tier List
  • Anime Expeditions codes
  • Supporters only
  • Deals
  • Buy eShop codes
  • Pokémon Go Cramorant
  • Fortnite admin panel codes

These rewards mostly include Gems, which are used to unlock and upgrade abilities. Some codes may grant Stat Resets or Class Rerolls depending on the update.

For more free rewards, check out our updated My Dragon Island codes, Fruit Battlegrounds codes, and Hunty Zombie codes lists for the latest working codes and in-game bonuses.

Expired Solo Hunters Codes

200KLIKES, 30KCCU, 35KCCUTHANKS33, 40KCCUTHANKS66, 50KCCUTHANKSZ, 75KCCUTHANKYOU, 80KLIKESLETSGOO, ABDUCTEDBYROBLOXIANS, ARIGATOJP, CLASSREROLL, CURSEDCOMMANDER, DANKEGERMANY, DEMONCASTLE, DEMONKINGV2, DUBSALLAROUND, GEM222ZZZZ, GEMZZZZ, GOMAWOYO, GRACIASLATAM, GRAZIEITALIA, LOVETOBRAZIL, MERCIFRANCE, OBRIGADOBR, ORCCASTLE, ORCUPDATE, PORTALREWORK, RAA333AAAAPART2, RAAAAAAAA, RAAAAAAAAPART2, RAIDFIXED, RANDOMUPD, RELEASE, RESETMYSTATS, REVERTXD, ROCKETSWORD, SALAMATPH, SHABORUSSIA, SOLOHUNTERSISBACK, SORRYABOUTUPD, SORRYFORLONGDELAY, SUB2SISTERGUARD, TERIMAKASIHID, THANKSFORTHELIKESGUYS, THANKSFORTHELOVE, THXFORTHEHYPE, TOTHEMOON, UPDATETHISWEEKEND, UPDMONDAY, WWWW

What Do Solo Hunters Codes Give?

Most codes reward one of the following:

  • Gems – The main in-game currency used for unlocking and improving abilities.
  • Class Rerolls – Let’s you change your class if you are unhappy with your current one.
  • Stat Resets – Resets your allocated stats so you can rebuild your character properly.

If you are new, save rerolls until you understand how classes perform in higher-tier dungeons. Stat resets are best used when you want to completely change your build.

How to Redeem Codes in Solo Hunters

The redemption system differs slightly from that in most Roblox games. You cannot enter codes from a menu. You must visit a specific NPC in the Overworld.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Launch Solo Hunters in Roblox.
  2. Complete the opening tutorial until you unlock the Overworld.
  3. Press Start Dungeon if needed and wake up in the Overworld area.
  4. Press M on PC to open the map.
  5. Head all the way south toward the dock area.
  6. Look for the blue NPC wearing a red hat near the crane.
  7. Approach the NPC and press E to interact.
  8. Enter a working code in the text box.
  9. Click Redeem.

On mobile, the map shortcut may not be available. Simply walk south from spawn until you reach the docks.

Why Is My Solo Hunter’s code not working?

If a code fails, it is usually for one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed it incorrectly.
  • You copied an extra space before or after the code.
  • The game servers have just been updated and will take a minute to refresh.

Codes are sometimes case-sensitive in Roblox games, so the safest option is to copy and paste directly. Each code can only be redeemed once per account.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

How Often Are New Codes Released?

New codes usually appear:

  • After major updates
  • During bug fixes
  • When the game hits milestones
  • During seasonal events

Developers typically share code in their official Discord server, mostly inside the announcements channel. Since they do not always tag players, many people miss them. That is why keeping this page bookmarked saves time. We update this page as soon as new codes drop. 

What Is Solo Hunters?

Solo Hunters is a dungeon-crawling Roblox RPG inspired by Solo Leveling. You start as a weak hunter and gradually grow stronger by clearing dungeons, defeating bosses, collecting loot, and upgrading abilities. Each dungeon has multiple rooms, tougher enemies, and a final boss that tests your build.

Your stats directly impact performance. Strength, Defense, Health, Attack Speed, and Critical Chance all shape your playstyle. A poorly planned build can slow your progress. A smart build can make even higher-tier dungeons manageable.

Codes help bridge that gap. They give you flexibility. They give you second chances. And in a game where scaling matters, that flexibility is powerful.

Final Thoughts

Solo Hunters reward patience and smart build planning. Codes are not just free rewards. They are tools that help you refine your character and stay competitive as updates roll out.

Redeem active codes quickly, experiment carefully with rerolls, and use stat resets only when you understand your class direction. That is how you grow from a rookie hunter into one of the strongest players in the dungeon.

In case you missed

  • 99 Nights in the Forest Codes
  • Roblox Music Codes
  • Roblox You VS Homer Codes
  • Roblox Knockout Codes
  • Roblox Horse Life Codes

title.rendered: Roblox Control Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Control Codes on September 05, 2026

Walking into Control feels familiar in the worst possible way. You have a badge, a flashlight, and that quiet dread that something is watching you from the dark corners of the facility. Inspired by Remedy’s Control, this Roblox horror experience puts you in the role of a C.T.R.L. employee whose job quickly turns into a fight for survival. And in a place where every mistake can be fatal, Control codes become your lifeline.

These codes give you free money and fragments, the two resources that decide whether you walk out prepared or panic-stricken. Below is a complete, up-to-date breakdown of every working Control code, what they give, how to redeem them, and where to find more when new updates drop.

All Working Control Codes

  • ROCKSTAR: 3000 Money and 30 Fragments (NEW)
  • 2KCOUNTING: 4000 Money and 35 Fragments (NEW)
  • SORRY4DELAY2: 5000 Money and 30 Fragments (NEW)
  • SORRY!: 5000 Money and 25 Fragments

The developers regularly release codes alongside updates, bug fixes, milestones, and seasonal events. Each code rewards you with money, fragments, or both, helping you unlock cosmetics, upgrades, and progression essentials.

All codes above are verified and working as of 2026; redeem them as soon as possible before they expire.

Are There Any Expired Control Codes?

1KGOAL!, 3KFOLLOWERS, BIGUPDATE, BUGFIXES01, BUGFIXES02, BUGFIXES03, CHRISTMAS, CONTROL, FARMERUPD, FIXES, LOSTHOPE, MASTERY, NEWCLASSES!, RELEASE, UPDATE01, VALENTINE!

What Do Control Codes Actually Give You?

Control codes mainly reward money and fragments, both of which are essential for progression. Money is currently used to unlock skins and emotes, letting you customize your character and stand out in the facility. While cosmetics won’t save you from the horrors directly, feeling confident in your look can strangely make the fear easier to face.

Fragments are more valuable long-term. They act as key materials tied to upgrades and progression systems, making them crucial as the game evolves through updates.

How to Redeem Control Codes in Roblox

Redeeming codes in Control is quick and simple, even when your nerves are shot. Just follow these steps carefully:

  1. Open Control on Roblox.
  2. Click the Codes button on the left or bottom-left of the screen.
  3. Type or paste a working code into the text box.
  4. Press Claim to receive your rewards instantly.

Once redeemed, your money and fragments will immediately appear in your account.

Why Your Control Code Might Not Be Working

If a code doesn’t work, don’t panic. The issue is usually simple. A single typo, missing letter, or extra space can invalidate a code. Always copy and paste codes directly to avoid mistakes. Also, make sure your internet connection is stable and that you haven’t already redeemed the same code before.

If problems persist, restarting the Roblox client often fixes hidden glitches.

Where to Find More Control Codes

New Control codes usually drop during updates, bug fixes, and community milestones. To stay ahead:

  • Bookmark this page, we update the codes when we find new ones. 
  • Join the official Control Discord server and watch the #codes channel
  • Become a member of the Control Corporation Roblox group for news and possible exclusive rewards

You can also explore the Control Wiki for deep dives into entities, classes, items, and survival strategies if you want to be fully prepared.

Final Thoughts

Control isn’t just another Roblox horror game. It’s a slow-burning experience built on tension, isolation, and the fear of the unknown. Control codes soften that edge just enough to help you breathe, prepare, and push forward.

Redeem every code, gear up wisely, and remember—sometimes survival isn’t about being fearless, but about being prepared when the lights go out.

  • Roblox Knockout Codes
  • Roblox Horse Life Codes
  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes

title.rendered: Waste Time Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Waste Time Codes on September 03, 2026

There’s something oddly comforting about a game that doesn’t rush you, judge you, or demand your attention every second. Waste Time on Roblox leans fully into that feeling. It’s a game built around the quiet idea that doing nothing can still move you forward and somehow, that makes it deeply relatable.

In this guide, we’ll walk through Waste Time codes, what they are, why they matter, how to use them, and how they quietly shape your progress while you sit back and let time pass.

All Active Waste Time Codes

  • ClansUPD: Free Rewards

Some sources list expiration dates for certain codes, while others still show them as active. To be safe, redeem codes as soon as possible. Idle games reward patience, but codes rarely do.

Expired Waste Time Codes

10MILLIONVISITSWOW, 20KCCU, ADMINPANEL, CALAMITYISAMAZING, CARDS, CENTRAL, CHAPTER3, CHAPTERIV, CLANSAREFIXED, COMPENSATION, DAILYREWARDS, EASTEREVENT, ETHEREALONTOP, FOLLOWDEVHAMED, FREECLICKS, FREELOCKSFR, FREEREROLLSFR, FUNNYCODE, GULLIBLE, HOLYMOLY, IMSORRYLOWK, IMSOSORRY, MOREBOOSTS, MORECLICKSFR, MORETREE, NEWPILLAR, OBBY, PRADIZYASKINGFORNEWCODE, QOL, QUESTSHERE, QUICK, RUINED, SON, SORRY3, SORRYFORBROKENCLANS, SORRYFORDELAY, SORRYFORDELAY2, SORRYFORDELAYII, SORRYFORNOTFIXINGCLANSYET, SORRYFORP2W, STPATRICKS, SUPERDUPERHIDDEN, THANKYOU, VALENTINES, VALENTINES2, WEHAVECODESNOW, WEREBACK, WOWOWOOWOWOWOWOWOOWOWOWO, YESANOTHERCODE, YETANOTHERCOMPENSATION

What Is Waste Time, Really?

At its core, Waste Time is an incremental simulator where existing in the game is the gameplay. You earn Time simply by staying in the world. That Time is then converted into Eons, which multiply how fast you earn even more Time. Over time, this loop opens up new areas, portals, and exponential growth.

It sounds simple and it is but that simplicity is exactly what makes the game special.

This is where Waste Time codes step in. They don’t change the spirit of the game. Instead, they gently smooth the edges, giving you small boosts that respect your time rather than replace it.

What Are Waste Time Codes and Why They Matter

Waste Time codes are free promotional rewards released by the developers, No time at all. These codes give you items that help fine-tune your progress instead of forcing you to grind harder.

Most codes reward one of four things:

  • Enchantment Rerolls, which let you roll for better bonuses
  • Enchantment Locks, which protect good bonuses from being overwritten
  • Highest Reset Stat multipliers, which massively boost long-term progress
  • Button Clicks, which speed up certain in-game actions

Individually, these rewards seem small. Together, they quietly reshape how fast and how far you can goespecially if you play passively or AFK.

How to Redeem Waste Time Codes

You can’t redeem codes immediately when you join the game, and that’s intentional. Waste Time wants you to experience its loop first. After playing for a short while and converting enough Time into Eons, the code system unlocks naturally.

  1. Launch Waste Time on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Scroll icon on the right side of your screen.
  3. Open it and select the Codes section.
  4. Enter or paste a working code.
  5. Press Redeem and enjoy the reward.

Codes are generally case-sensitive, so copying and pasting is the safest way to avoid mistakes.

Why a Code Might Not Work

If a code fails, it’s usually for one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired
  • The code was already redeemed on your account
  • There’s a spelling or capitalization error
  • The servers haven’t refreshed after a recent update

If a brand-new code doesn’t work right away, waiting a short while or rejoining the game often fixes the issue.

Other Free Boosts You Might Miss

Codes aren’t the only way to gain free advantages in Waste Time. The game quietly rewards social and passive play.

Playing with friends grants a percentage-based Time boost, which stacks depending on how many friends are in your server. You can also gain extra boosts by:

  • Liking the game
  • Following the developers
  • Joining the official Roblox group

These bonuses may seem small, but in an exponential system, even tiny boosts grow loud over time.

Unlocking New Areas and Why Eons Matter

Once you collect 100 Eons, which requires converting 100,000 Time, you unlock a new zone with three important portals:

  • The Library – Requires 10M Time and grants a 1.5× boost
  • The Future – Requires 1Sx Time and grants a 2× boost
  • The End – Requires 1Td Time and grants a 5× boost

Converting Time into Eons isn’t optionalit’s the heart of progression. Each Eon adds a +50% boost, and those boosts compound faster than most players expect.

Where to Find New Waste Time Codes

New codes are usually released during updates, milestones, or compensation events. The most reliable sources are:

  • The official Waste Time Discord server
  • Developer announcements from No time at all
  • Regularly updated code-tracking pages

Bookmark this page to stay updated without chasing announcements.

Final Thoughts: Why Waste Time Codes Feel Different

Most games use codes to push you forward faster. Waste Time uses them to make waiting feel better. That’s the quiet genius of it.

These codes don’t rush you. They sit in your inventory, patiently amplifying progress while you do what the game encourages mostnothing at all.

And in a world that’s always asking for more effort, that feels surprisingly refreshing.

In case you missed

  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Control Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes
  • Anime Spike Codes
  • My Dragon Island Codes

title.rendered: Anime Spike Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Spike Codes on September 03, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes inside Anime Spike, you already know the feeling. Waves of anime-inspired enemies keep coming, progress feels slow at the start, and every upgrade matters. That is exactly where Anime Spike codes step in. These codes are not just bonuses; they are the game’s way of giving players a fair push forward without spending Robux.

Whether you are a new player trying to survive the early grind or a regular player looking to optimize your loadout, this guide walks you through everything you need to know. From the latest working codes to how to redeem them and why they sometimes fail, consider this your complete and reliable companion.

All Working Anime Spike Codes

  • UPDATE4: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions (NEW)
  • update2: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs3: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs2: Redeem this code for 99 Spikes, 3 Coins Potions, 3 Damage Potions, 3 Energy Potions, and 3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs: Redeem this code for 3 Coins Potions, 3 Damage Potions, 3 Energy Potions, and 3 Lucky Potions
  • SrryDelay: Redeem this code for 1 Coins Potion, 1 Damage Potion, 1 Energy Potion, and 1 Lucky Potion
  • bugsfixed: Redeem this code for 1 Coins Potion, 1 Damage Potion, 1 Energy Potion, and 1 Lucky Potion
  • SrryShut: Redeem this code for 1 Coins Potion, 1 Damage Potion, 1 Energy Potion, and 1 Lucky Potion
  • srryshut2: Redeem this code for 2 Coins Potions, 2 Damage Potions, 2 Energy Potions, and 2 Lucky Potions
  • Release: Redeem this code for 1 Energy Potion

The developers regularly release codes to apologize for bugs, delays, or server shutdowns, and each one brings valuable rewards like potions and spikes. These items directly affect your damage, energy, luck, and coin gains, making progression much smoother.

Each potion provides a temporary boost that can dramatically change how fast you clear enemies. When used smartly, especially during tough waves or early progression, these rewards can save hours of grinding.

Are There Any Expired Anime Spike Codes?

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Anime Spike Codes

Redeeming codes in Anime Spike is quick and beginner-friendly. You do not need to reach a certain level or complete any missions beforehand.

Follow these steps carefully to claim your rewards:

  1. Launch Anime Spike on Roblox.
  2. Look to the left side of the screen and click the Shop (shopping cart) icon.
  3. Scroll down until you find the code input box.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Click the Redeem button.

Once redeemed successfully, your rewards are added instantly, ready to be used whenever you need them.

What Are Spikes and Potions Used For?

Understanding the rewards helps you use them wisely instead of wasting them early.

Spikes are a special in-game currency. They allow you to purchase exclusive items without spending Robux, making them extremely valuable for free-to-play players.

Potions provide temporary buffs that improve key stats like damage output, energy regeneration, coin earnings, and luck. These boosts are especially powerful when facing tougher enemies or pushing into new areas.

There are also rocks, which can be used for special gacha systems like Biju pulls, offering power boosts ranging from common to legendary.

Why Are My Anime Spike Codes Not Working?

If a code fails, it is usually for a simple reason. Here are the most common issues players face:

  • The code was typed incorrectly (codes are case-sensitive).
  • The code has already been redeemed on your account.
  • The code expired without notice.
  • Temporary server or internet connection issues.

To avoid problems, copy and paste codes directly and rejoin a fresh server if redemption fails the first time.

How to Get More Anime Spike Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page and check back often. Developers usually release new code during updates, bug fixes, or unexpected shutdowns.

You can also keep an eye on:

  • The official Anime Spike Discord server (when available)
  • The ?¿ Company Roblox group for announcements and updates

New codes often drop quietly, so staying connected gives you an advantage.

Final Thoughts

Anime Spike is built around steady progression, and codes are a core part of that design. They reward patience, soften the grind, and make the game more enjoyable, especially for players who prefer not to spend Robux.

If you use these codes wisely and keep an eye out for new ones, you will find yourself clearing waves faster, upgrading smarter, and enjoying the game for what it truly is: a fast-paced, anime-inspired experience that respects your time.

In case you missed

  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Control Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes
  • My Dragon Island Codes
  • Waste Time Codes

title.rendered: My Dragon Island Codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest My Dragon Island Codes on September 03, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes inside My Dragon Island, you already know the feeling. Progress starts slowly, coins take time to stack up, and feeding dragons can quickly drain whatever money you earn. The game looks peaceful on the surface, but building a strong dragon farm takes patience. That is exactly why My Dragon Island codes matter so much.

These codes give you free coins and, in some cases, premium currency, which means faster growth, better eggs, and less grinding. Instead of waiting hours for your farm to scale up, codes give you a small but very meaningful push forward.

What Is My Dragon Island

My Dragon Island is a Roblox farming game built around dragons instead of animals. You buy eggs from the shop, hatch them on your island, and place the dragons on your farm. Once placed, dragons generate passive income over time.

The core loop is simple but satisfying. You feed dragons fruits and vegetables to level them up. Bigger dragons earn more money. More money lets you buy rarer eggs. The feature that really makes the game stand out is that you can mount any dragon you own and fly around the map, explore floating islands, and even take part in battles against other players or AI.

It is relaxing, a little grindy, and very rewarding once things start clicking.

All Working My Dragon Island Codes

  • LOVEWINGS: Coins (NEW)
  • DRAGONHEART: Redeem this code for 5,000 Coins and 1,250 Gems
  • DRAGONFEST: Redeem this code for 15,000 Coins and 750 Gems

The developers release code during updates and events, but they usually do not stay active for long. Some websites list slightly different rewards for the same codes, which likely comes from balance changes or server-side updates. Based on the latest updates, these are the currently working codes players are reporting.

Expired My Dragon Island Codes

FIREWORKS

How to Redeem My Dragon Island Codes

Redeeming codes in My Dragon Island is quick and beginner-friendly. You do not need to reach a certain level or complete any tasks first.

  1. Launch My Dragon Island on Roblox.
  2. Click the Cog icon at the top right.
  3. Select the Codes option in the Settings menu.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Redeem to claim your rewards.

Why My Dragon Island Codes Sometimes Do Not Work

If a code does not work, it usually is not a bug. The reasons below explain most issues players run into.

  • The code has expired and is no longer active.
  • The code was typed incorrectly or used with wrong capitalization.
  • The code was already redeemed on your account.
  • The game server has not refreshed after a new update.

How To Get More My Dragon Island Codes

The fastest way to stay updated is to follow the sources below, since new codes often expire quickly.

  • Join the official My Dragon Island Discord server.
  • Join the RaiseAVale Roblox group.
  • Bookmark this page and check back regularly for new codes.

Why Using Codes Early Matters

Using codes early in My Dragon Island changes the entire experience. Instead of slowly waiting for your first few dragons to generate income, you can buy better eggs immediately and start scaling faster. It saves time, reduces frustration, and lets you enjoy the fun parts of the game sooner.

If you are serious about building a powerful dragon farm, redeeming codes should be the first thing you do every time a new update drops.

  • Anime Spike Codes

How to Redeem Anime Eternal Codes

Redeeming codes is quick once you know where the option is.

  1. Launch Anime Eternal on Roblox
  2. Click the Shop button on the left
  3. Scroll to the very bottom of the shop menu
  4. Enter a working code
  5. Press Redeem

If you do not see the code box, scroll further down. This is the most common reason players think codes are broken.

Where Do New Anime Eternal Codes Come From

Codes are released directly by the developer through official channels.

  • Anime Eternal Discord server, mainly the #codes channel
  • Major game updates and rebalances
  • Holiday events like Halloween and Christmas
  • Milestones for likes, favorites, visits, and player counts
  • Bug fixes and emergency shutdowns

If you do not want to track Discord, bookmarking a regularly updated code page is the easiest option.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

Why Your Anime Eternal Code is Not Working

Most code issues are simple and not bugs.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or an extra space
  • Servers have not refreshed after an update
  • The code was entered in the wrong menu

Copy and paste codes when possible. After a new update, rejoin the game before redeeming.

What is Anime Eternal

Anime Eternal is a Roblox incremental game built around fast scaling progression. You click to gain energy, use that energy to fight enemies across different worlds, and open stars to unlock anime-inspired heroes. As you move forward, every system scales quickly, from enemy strength to upgrade costs, which makes resource management important.

The game pulls characters and worlds from multiple anime series rather than focusing on a single franchise. Names and designs are altered, but the inspiration is clear across heroes, maps, and abilities.

Final Thoughts

Anime Eternal codes are part of normal progression, not optional bonuses. Using them early saves time and reduces grind. Check for new codes after every update, use rewards carefully, and avoid sitting on stat resets. In this game, timing matters as much as raw power.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Fruit Battlegrounds Codes on September 03, 2026

If you love spinning for devil fruits in Roblox’s Fruit Battlegrounds, you already know how precious gems are. Whether you’re chasing that legendary fruit or looking to power up faster, Fruit Battlegrounds codes can give you a major boost.

Below you’ll find all the latest active codes, how to redeem them, and a few quick tips to level up faster.

All Working Fruit Battlegrounds Codes

  • HIGHER1M120K: 800 Gems (NEW)
  • EVENHIGHER!: Free Gems (NEW)
  • YOO1M110K!: 2000 Gems
  • BIGMILLIHUNNID!: Free Rewards
  • ITSTHEBILLION!: 600 Gems
  • CODEFIX: Free Title
  • FLYING1M80K

Expired Fruit Battlegrounds Codes

1M40KRAZY!!, 1M50INSANE, 1M60WOWZER, 3LAPSED!, 4BUNDANCY, 4MPUTAT3, 530GYAT, 540DAYUM, 550POGG, 570FAVS, 580FLAMES, 650ISMADD!, 710KOMG!!, 730EXPLODE, 750KINSANE!, 760KISKRAZY, 770KWOW!, 810TIME!, 830KBRO!, 840MENTAL, 860KHYPEE, 870OMG!, 930KINS4NITY, 940KHAPPYDAYZ, 950KOMGGG!, ANTICIPATION, AYO640K!, AYY1M30!, BAM700K, BIG1M170K!!, BIG8HUNDO!, BIGB1RD, BIGDAY, BIGUPDATE20, CLEANREB00T, CLOSERR990K!, COOKEDPASTRY!, CRASHL4NDING!, DAHUNT2024, FREEBOOT!, FREEBOTAGAIN, GLITTER780K, HAHA740K!, HIGH590, HOWLINGFALL!, HYPEE920K!, HYPEWHOLECAKE, IAMLEOPARD, ICEW0LF, ILOV3C4NDY, ITSTIME!!, JEEZ630, KOLDKRAZE!, LAGFIXX, LAVAPARTY, LETSGOO130K, LOL960K!, LOLX880K!, LVLBUFFHYPE, MAGNIFICENT890K!!, MILLITEN!, MOSTH4TED, N3WW0RLD!, NANAP0CALYPSE!, NEWBOUNTYERA!, NEWYEAR2025!!, OMG600K!!!, OMG9HUNDRED!, OMGBIGMILLI!!!, OMGREBOOTAGAIN, OMGUPDATE19!, OMGUPDATE22, PLEASEZAKINEEDTHIS, POS1T1V1TY, POW680K!, POW970K, REBOOTPART2, RIGHT720, SCORCHINGSUMMER, SHEEESH520!!, SHINE790K, SM4LLFRY, SORRY4DELAY, SORRYMOBILE, SPLENDID820, SPR34DL0V3, THANKSFORDAMILLY, THEMARINEHERO, THXFOR610!!, TIMEISVALUABLE, TRUEMENACE, UNLOCK690K!, UPDATE21!, VALENTINES2024, WINTAH2023, WINTER2024!, WORLDWAR2025, WOW1MIL20!, WOW850, WOWZER620!, WOWZER910, YOOO560

How to Redeem Codes in Fruit Battlegrounds

Redeeming your codes is simple, but you need to do it correctly to make sure you get your gems instantly.

Here’s how to redeem Fruit Battlegrounds codes:

  1. Open Fruit Battlegrounds in Roblox.
  2. Click Spin Fruit from the main menu.
  3. Tap the Treasure Chest in the middle of the screen.
  4. Look for the Codes section in the bottom-left corner.
  5. Enter a working code and click Redeem.

If the code is valid, your gems will appear immediately. If it says “Invalid or Expired,” try copying and pasting the code directly to avoid typos. If you enjoy Fruit Battlegrounds, you might also want to grab rewards in other hit Roblox games.

Check out our latest Blue Lock Rivals codes for free spins, claim boosts with Type Soul codes, and unlock stylish items using Dress to Impress codes.

Why Your Fruit Battlegrounds Codes Might Not Work

If a code doesn’t work, here’s what might be going on:

  • Check for typos: Copy and paste the code directly from the list instead of typing it.
  • Expired or inactive codes: Codes often stop working after an update or when a new milestone is reached.
  • Already redeemed: If you see the message “Code already redeemed,” it means you’ve already used it on your account.
  • Server delays: Occasionally, Roblox servers take a few minutes to process new codes, so wait a bit and try again.
  • Capitalization: Codes are case-sensitive, make sure you enter them exactly as shown.

How to Get More Fruit Battlegrounds Codes

New codes usually appear when developer POPO releases major updates or when the game hits new milestones. To stay updated:

  • Join the official Discord: Look for the “fb-updates” channel managed by developer POPO.
  • Or you can simply bookmark this page. We will check and update working codes everyday.

Tips to Level Up Faster and Earn More Gems

Getting the best devil fruits takes more than luck. Here’s how you can maximize your progress:

  • Spin Smart: Every 100 spins guarantees a good fruit, so save gems and spin in batches.
  • Master Your Moves: The more you use your abilities, the stronger they become.
  • Daily Login: Don’t skip your daily rewards—they add up fast.
  • Use AFK Mode: Stay in the AFK Chamber to earn gems even while you’re offline.
  • Complete Achievements: Unlock new titles and free gems as you progress.

That’s everything you need to know about the latest Fruit Battlegrounds codes for. Keep checking back for new codes as updates drop, and don’t forget to redeem them before they expire. Use your gems wisely, spin smart, and aim for those legendary fruits that make every fight unforgettable!

title.rendered: Anime Apocalypse codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Apocalypse Codes on September 06, 2026

Anime Apocalypse is the kind of Roblox game that gets chaotic fast. One moment you are fighting zombies in anime-inspired maps like Shibuya, and the next moment you are rolling for stronger abilities, better gadgets, and traits that can completely change your run.

That is why codes matter here. They give you free Coins, Raid Tickets, Trait Rerolls, Ability Spins, Gadget Spins, and timed boosts, so you can start stronger instead of grinding from zero. Below, you will find all active Anime Apocalypse codes, what they give, how to redeem them, and what to do if a code does not work.

All Active Anime Apocalypse codes

  • SUBARU: Coins, Raid tickets, Trait rerolls, Lucky ability spins, Lucky gadget spins, and Double drops and Double coins boosts (NEW)
  • GUILDBATTLES: Coins, Raid tickets, Trait rerolls, Lucky ability spins, Lucky gadget spins, and Double drops and Double coins boosts (NEW)
  • WORLDBOSS: Coins, Raid tickets, Trait rerolls, Lucky ability spins, Lucky gadget spins, and Double drops and Double coins boosts (NEW)
  • ZOLTRAAK: Coins, Raid tickets, Trait rerolls, Lucky ability spins, Lucky gadget spins, and Double drops and Double coins boosts
  • GUILDWARS: Coins, Raid tickets, Trait rerolls, Lucky ability spins, Lucky gadget spins, and Double drops and Double coins boosts

Redeem these codes as soon as possible. Roblox codes can expire without much warning, and some Anime Apocalypse codes may only work on new or private servers.

The exact reward amount may change after updates, but the important part is simple: these codes give you the resources you need to roll more, upgrade faster, and survive longer.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Roblox RIVALS codes, Tower Defense Simulator codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Anime Apocalypse codes

15KINTERESTED, 20KSLURPS, 20KTHANKS, 25KINTERESTED, 50KINTERESTED, 5KFOLLOWERS!, 60KINTERESTED, ANTIMAGIC, BABYLON, BEYONDTHEWALLS, BONUSCODEFORSJW, BUGPATCHESGETSBOOMED, CROCODILEPASS, DOMAINEXPANSION, EYEPATCH, GETSUGA, GHOSTOFSHINOBI, GODOFWAR, HEADOFHEI, HOGYOKU, HOLLOW, IAMATOMIC, INTHESHADOWS, KINGOFCURSESEVO, LETTHEAURAFARMSTART, LIMITEDABILITY, MADEINHEAVEN, MAJORBUGFIXES, MATCHBUGFIXED, MOONANDKING, MOONSLAYER, MOROCCO, NEWGAMEMODE, NUMBERONE, OVERHEAVEN, PATCHFIXES, PRIMERAESPADA, PRIMORDIALDEVIL, REDHAIRED, RELEASE!, SBRUPDATE, SHADOWGARDEN, SHADOWMONARCH, SHINOBI, SORRYFORARESTART, SORRYFORBUGS, SORRYFORDELAY, SORRYFORLOBBYSHUTDOWN, SORRYFORSHUTDOWN, SOUL, SUMMEREVENT, THANKSFOR5K, THANKSFOR7KPLAYERS, THANKYOUFOR10K, THANKYOUFOR10K2, THEALMIGHTY, THESTORMISAPPROACHING, THESTRONGEST, THETEMPESTKING, THXFORPLAYING, TOJIRELEASE, WAVEDEFENSE, WHITEREAPER, WORLDPASS, ZANGETSU

How to redeem Anime Apocalypse codes

Anime Apocalypse makes code redemption simple. You do not need to finish a tutorial or reach a certain level first.

  1. Open Anime Apocalypse on Roblox.
  2. Click the Codes button on the right side of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code in the text box.
  4. Press Confirm to claim your rewards.

Copy and paste the codes exactly as written. Some codes use capital letters, numbers, or punctuation, and even one missing character can stop the reward from working.

Why your Anime Apocalypse code is not working

If a code does not work, do not panic right away. In Anime Apocalypse, the problem is often the server, not the code itself.

Some new codes only work on the latest game version. Public servers can stay open on older versions for a while, so the safest fix is to join a fresh server or create a private server. Private servers usually load the newest version of the game, which gives the code a better chance of working.

If that does not fix it, check the code spelling. Roblox codes are usually case-sensitive, so it is better to copy the code directly instead of typing it by hand. You can also restart Roblox to make sure your client is fully updated before trying again.

What is Anime Apocalypse?

Anime Apocalypse is a Roblox survival hack-and-slash game where anime-style heroes fight waves of zombies. The game mixes fast combat, dungeon-style survival, character upgrades, and gacha-like spins for abilities and gadgets.

The setup is easy to understand but fun to grind. You enter a map, clear zombie waves, pick perk cards between rounds, and keep improving your character with better abilities, gadgets, traits, and mastery. Maps like Shibuya and Impel Down give the game a strong anime feel, while the zombie waves keep every run active.

Codes help because they give you the resources that usually take time to earn. Coins help with progression, Raid Tickets give access to more content, Trait Rerolls help fine-tune your build, and Spins let you chase stronger abilities and gadgets.

The game is available on PC, mobile, and console, so you can play it on most Roblox-supported devices.

How to get more Anime Apocalypse codes

The best place to find new Anime Apocalypse codes is the official Anime Apocalypse Discord server. After joining, you may need to verify with Rover, then check the code channel for new drops.

You can also follow the Anime Apocalypse Dev Roblox group for game updates. Still, codes are easy to miss because admins may not always ping everyone when a new one drops.

Bookmark this page so you can quickly check the latest Anime Apocalypse codes whenever the game gets an update, hits a player milestone, or releases a new reward drop.

  • Roblox Ryujin codes
  • Anime Rails codes

title.rendered: Tower Defense Simulator codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Tower Defense Simulator Codes on September 03, 2026

Tower Defense Simulator is one of those Roblox games where every small reward helps. A free crate, a skin, or a few extra resources may not instantly make you unstoppable, but it can make the early grind feel smoother and give you one more reason to jump back into another match.

TDS codes are usually released during updates, events, milestones, holidays, or special community moments. They do not stay active forever, so it is worth redeeming any working code as soon as you see it.

All Active Tower Defense Simulator codes

  • 1MILCOMMUNITY: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • 2MILLION: Free Rewards (NEW)

Codes in Tower Defense Simulator are case-sensitive. Copy the code exactly as shown above, including capital letters and symbols, otherwise the game may reject it.

Right now, there is only one safely confirmed working Tower Defense Simulator code from the available sources. Some older codes are still listed as active on one source, but another source already marks them as expired, so the safest approach is to try the confirmed code first.

Expired Tower Defense Simulator codes

02MOMENT, 1BILLION, 1POINT7MIL, 1PUMPKIN, 200KMAY, 30K, 4BVISITS, 5KMILESTONE, 9509253943, B1RDHUNT3R, BEACHGLAD2022, BLOXY21, CELEBRATION21, CHRISTMAS2025, COMMUNITY20, DELAYED, DOUBLEBLOXIES, ELECTRO, ENTERCODEHERE, FIFTYK, HAPPY3AST3R!, HAPPYHALLOWEEN, ICYFREEZE, IMABABY, IMCONSUMING, JOHNRETURNS, M3RRY2022TDS, MERRY2021, MERRY2024, MERRYXMAS2023, MOARXP, NAMETAGSRCOOL, NEWYEAR2021, NOTESLA?, QNJOU11, ROBLOXISBACK, SPR1NGM1L3ST0NE, SW33TXP, TDS5YEARS !, TDS5YEARS!, W33KLICODE

How to redeem Tower Defense Simulator codes

Redeeming codes in Tower Defense Simulator is simple, but the button location can be easy to miss if you are opening the game after a long break. Once you are inside the experience, you only need the code menu and a working code.

  1. Open Tower Defense Simulator on Roblox.
  2. Click the codes button or icon on the screen.
  3. Enter a working code into the text box.
  4. Press Redeem.
  5. If the code is valid, your reward will be added to your account.

If the code does not work, check the spelling first. Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code. If it still fails, the code has probably expired.

Why your TDS code is not working

Tower Defense Simulator codes can stop working without much warning. A code may be tied to a seasonal event, a major update, a visit milestone, or a limited-time celebration, so it may disappear once that moment passes.

The most common reasons are simple: the code was typed incorrectly, the code is case-sensitive, the code has expired, or the reward has special requirements. For example, one older code was reported to require the Farm Tower before it could be redeemed, which means some players could not use it even when it was listed as active.

If you are sure the code was entered correctly and it still does not work, it is better to treat it as expired instead of wasting more time on it.

How to get more Tower Defense Simulator codes

New TDS codes usually appear around updates, holidays, game milestones, and community announcements. The best places to watch are the official Tower Defense Simulator social pages, the Paradoxum Games Roblox group, and the official Discord server.

Players can also join the Paradoxum Games Roblox group for an extra starting cash bonus in-game. This is not the same as a redeemable code, but it can still help when you are starting a match and trying to place your first towers faster.

Bookmark this page if you want a simple place to check for new Tower Defense Simulator codes. We will update the list when new rewards are released or old codes stop working.

What is Tower Defense Simulator?

Tower Defense Simulator is a Roblox tower defense game where you place towers, defend your base, and fight through waves of enemies. The core loop is easy to understand but hard to fully master, especially when stronger enemies start pushing through your defenses.

Coins, gems, crates, skins, and towers all matter because they help you grow your loadout over time. Codes are not a replacement for playing the game, but they are a nice bonus when you want free rewards without grinding extra waves.

That is why TDS codes are always worth checking. Even one free crate can give you something useful, and in a game built around slow upgrades and better loadouts, every little reward counts.

title.rendered: Roblox RIVALS codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Roblox Rivals Codes on September 06, 2026

RIVALS is one of Roblox’s biggest shooting games, and its codes matter more than they first seem. The rewards usually give you Keys, Community Wraps, and other small cosmetics that help you unlock weapons faster or make your loadout feel more personal.

The game is built around fast PvP fights, from tight 1v1 duels to bigger team matches that feel closer to a Roblox version of a tactical shooter. If you are jumping in often, these codes are worth redeeming early because RIVALS codes can expire quickly after updates.

All Active RIVALS codes

  • FREE191: 3 Keys (NEW)
  • COCONUTBONK: 250 Pearls (NEW)
  • RIVALSSUMMER: 3 Tropical Chests
  • COMMUNITY24: 1 Community Wrap
  • BOOST: 1 Key
  • BONUS: 1 Key
  • roblox_rtc: 5 Keys
  • ELBILLUG: Joke code with no reward

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Neo Tennis codes, Clover Origins codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired RIVALS codes

COMMUNITY24, FREE183, FREE194, MERRYMERRYXMAS<3, RELEASE, REWARD26, SORRY, SUMMERRR, TEN_BILLION_VISITS_OMG, THANKYOU_1BVISITS!, WRATH, 100MVISITS, 5B_VISITS_WHATTTTTT, BESTSHOOTERGAME, COMMUNITY, COMMUNITY10, COMMUNITY11, COMMUNITY12, COMMUNITY13, COMMUNITY14, COMMUNITY15, COMMUNITY16, COMMUNITY17, COMMUNITY18, COMMUNITY19, COMMUNITY2, COMMUNITY20, COMMUNITY21, COMMUNITY22, COMMUNITY23, COMMUNITY3, COMMUNITY4, COMMUNITY5, COMMUNITY6, COMMUNITY7, COMMUNITY8, COMMUNITY9, FREE100, FREE107, FREE127, FREE129, FREE133, FREE135, FREE137, FREE138, FREE150, FREE155, FREE158, FREE160, FREE165, FREE166, FREE167, FREE169, FREE171, FREE172, FREE173, FREE176, FREE177, FREE178, FREE181, FREE185, FREE187, FREE188, FREE189, FREE190, FREE191, HAPPYRIVALSWEEN, IREADCHANGELOGS

How to redeem RIVALS codes

RIVALS does not let every player redeem codes instantly. You first need to follow the required developer accounts and complete the game’s verification steps.

  1. Open RIVALS on Roblox.
  2. Follow the required X accounts, including @NosniyGames and @Sensei_RBX.
  3. Join the Nosniy Games Roblox group if the game asks for it.
  4. Launch the game and click plus icon at the top to open Shop
  5. Go to More and then Codes option in the menu. 
  6. Scroll to the code redemption section.
  7. Enter your Roblox username and verify your follows if asked.
  8. Paste a working code into the text box.
  9. Click Redeem to claim your reward.

If the code still does not work, check the spelling first. RIVALS codes are case-sensitive, so it is safer to copy and paste them exactly.

Why your RIVALS code is not working

Most RIVALS code errors come down to three things: the code expired, it was typed incorrectly, or your account has not completed the required follow and group verification.

You may also need to finish early shooting range tasks before the code system works properly. If you already did everything and the code still fails, the code has probably expired.

How to get more RIVALS codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page, because we will update it when new RIVALS codes arrive. Nosniy Games usually releases codes during updates, community milestones, special events, and major visit celebrations.

You can also check the official Nosniy Games Discord server, the developer’s X accounts, and the in-game update notes. RIVALS sometimes hides free rewards inside patch notes, so scroll to the end of update logs and look for a Claim Rewards button.

RIVALS moves fast, and so do its codes. Redeem the active ones as soon as possible, then come back later for new Keys, wraps, and other free rewards.

Missed This? Check It Out

  • Wheelie District codes
  • Roblox Ryujin codes
  • Anime Rails codes

Update: Verified the latest Neo Tennis Codes on September 03, 2026

Neo Tennis is one of those Roblox sports games where every point feels earned. You are not just tapping a button and watching the ball fly. You are timing your shots, reading your opponent, and trying to win rallies with style.

That grind is fun, but early upgrades can make a big difference. Neo Tennis codes help you claim free Lucky Spins, Spins, cash, and rackets, so you can unlock better items without spending extra time farming rewards.

  • Y7Q667XRSJK: Mythic Frozen Racket
  • GHZT2Q8MGDH: Redeem for 2 Spins
  • MCZW25EASR7: Rare Ice Racket

Roblox codes can expire without warning, so redeem them as soon as possible. If a code does not work, check the spelling first, then try copying it directly from the list.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Brainrot Evolution codes, Clover Origins codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Neo Tennis codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Neo Tennis codes

Redeeming codes in Neo Tennis is simple once you know where to go. The game does not hide the menu deep inside settings. You need to find the in-game code area and enter your reward there.

  1. Launch Neo Tennis on Roblox.
  2. Look for the hologram or area with CODE above it.
  3. Walk up to it and hold or press the prompted button, usually E.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Click the Check button to claim your reward.

If the code is valid, the reward should be added to your account right away. If it fails, the code may be expired, already redeemed, or typed incorrectly.

What are Neo Tennis codes used for?

Neo Tennis codes are useful because they give you free rewards that help with progression and customization. Most current codes give Lucky Spins or Spins, which can help you roll for better items. Some codes can also unlock special rackets, like the Ice Racket.

That matters because Neo Tennis is built around fast, stylish matches. The game was previously known as Tennis! and before that Tennis Clash, and it follows the same idea of turning regular tennis into a more energetic Roblox sports experience. Instead of plain rallies, you get powerful shots, flashy abilities, and matches that feel closer to an anime sports duel than a normal tennis game.

How to get more Neo Tennis codes

The easiest option is to bookmark this page, because we will update it when new codes are released or old ones stop working.

You can also check the official Neo Tennis Discord server. Codes are usually shared in the codes channel, but they may also appear in announcements or update logs when the developers push new content.

Why are my Neo Tennis codes not working?

A code can fail for a few simple reasons. Before assuming it is expired, check these common issues first.

  • The code was typed with a mistake.
  • The code has already been redeemed on your account.
  • The code has expired.
  • The game server has not refreshed yet.
  • The reward name changed after a newer update.

The safest method is to copy and paste the code exactly as shown. If it still does not work, restart Roblox and try again in a new server.

Final words

Neo Tennis is more fun when you are not stuck grinding for every small upgrade. These codes give you a quick boost with Lucky Spins, Spins, and a free racket, so you can spend more time playing matches and less time waiting for rewards.

Bookmark this page and check back often. New Neo Tennis codes can drop with updates, milestones, or Discord announcements, and we will keep the list fresh whenever more rewards arrive.

title.rendered: Clover Origins codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Clover Origins Codes on September 03, 2026

Clover Origins is built for players who love the Black Clover world but do not want to grind forever just to test a new build. Spins, Yen, stat resets, and boosts matter a lot here because they decide how quickly you can reroll your grimoire, change your race, try new traits, and push your character forward.

That is why Clover Origins codes are worth using as soon as possible. Most of the latest codes give the same strong reward bundle, while one code gives a timed EXP and Luck boost that is best used when you are ready to play actively.

All Active Clover Origins codes

  • GAMERELEASE!: 150K Yen and 150 Grimoire Spins (NEW)
  • CLASHWAR!: 100K Yen and 500 Grimoire Spins (NEW)
  • 23MVISITS!: 50K Yen and 50 Grimoire Spins (NEW)
  • 180KLIKES!: 3 Reset Stats (NEW)
  • INEMAFOO!: 30 Minute Double EXP and Double Yen (NEW)
  • RACESPIN!: 100 RACE Spins (NEW)
  • 175KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • 165KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • 170KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • 22MILLIONVISITS!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • RELEASEUPCOMING!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • 20MVISITS!: 10k Yens, 3 Stat Reset, 10 grimoire spins, 10 Broom Spins, 10 Race Spins, and 25 Trait Spins
  • 100KFAVS!: 10 Trait Spins
  • BUGFIXES16!: 6h double Luck, Exp, Mastery, Money
  • BUGFIXES17!: 150 Spins
  • THANKS7!: 50 RaceSpins and 25 Grimoire Spins
  • 150KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins
  • 160KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins
  • UPDATE9!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins
  • THANKS6!: 150 Race Spins, and 75 Grimoire Spins
  • BUGFIXES15!: Double Mastery, Money, Luck, and Experience for 1 hour
  • 140KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins
  • 145KLIKES!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins
  • UPDATE8!: 10k Yens, 3 reset stats, 10 grimoire spins, 10 broomspins, 10 racespins, and 25 trait spins

Use the codes below exactly as shown. Most Clover Origins codes include capital letters, numbers, and an exclamation mark at the end, so copying and pasting them is the safest option.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest World Fighters codes, Brainrot Evolution codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Clover Origins codes

100KLIKES!, 10KLIKES!, 110KLIKES!, 115KLIKES!, 11KLIKES!, 120KLIKES!, 125KLIKES!, 12KLIKES!, 130KLIKES!, 135KLIKES!, 13KLIKES!, 14KLIKES!, 15KLIKES!, 15MVISITS!, 16KLIKES!, 17KLIKES!, 18KLIKES!, 19KLIKES!, 1KLIKES!, 20KLIKES!, 21KLIKES!, 22KLIKES!, 23KLIKES!, 24KLIKES!, 25KLIKES!, 26KLIKES!, 27KLIKES!, 28KLIKES!, 29KLIKES!, 2KLIKES!, 30KLIKES!, 35KLIKES!, 3KLIKES!, 40KLIKES!, 45KLIKES!, 4KLIKES!, 50KLIKES!, 55KLIKES!, 5KLIKES!, 60KLIKES!, 65KLIKES!, 6KLIKES!, 70KLIKES!, 75KLIKES!, 7KLIKES!, 80KLIKES!, 85KLIKES!, 8KLIKES!, 9KLIKES!, BUGFIXES10!, BUGFIXES11!, BUGFIXES13!, BUGFIXES14!, DOUBLEMASTERY!, SHUTDOWNSORRY5!, SHUTDOWNSORRY7!, SORRYDELAY!, SORRYDELAY2!, SORRYSHUTDOWN!, THANKS!, THANKS2!, THANKS3!, THANKS4!, THANKS5!, UPDATE4!, UPDATE5!, UPDATEFIXES2!, UPDATESFIXES!

How to redeem Clover Origins codes

Before redeeming codes, you need to join the Funzy Labs Roblox group. If you skip that step, the code system may not work for you even if the code itself is active.

  1. Open Clover Origins on Roblox.
  2. Click the Menu button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Select Info from the menu.
  4. Enter a working code in the Code here box.
  5. Press Enter to claim your rewards.

Once the code works, the rewards should be added to your account. If you are using a boost code like SORRYSHUTDOWN!, redeem it only when you are ready to play, because timed boosts are more valuable when you can actually use the full duration.

Why your Clover Origins codes may not work

Clover Origins codes can fail for a few simple reasons, and the error message usually tells you what happened.

If the game says Invalid, check the spelling first. Codes are case-sensitive, and many of them end with an exclamation mark. A missing symbol or extra space can stop the code from working. If the code is brand new, it may also take a little time to appear across every server.

If the game says Codes Used, you have already claimed that code on your account. Clover Origins codes can only be redeemed once per player.

If the game says Expired, the developer has removed the code. In that case, you will need to use one of the current working codes instead.

How to get more Clover Origins codes

New Clover Origins codes usually arrive when the game reaches new like milestones, gets updates, receives bug fixes, or has a server shutdown. The Funzy Labs Discord server is the best official place to watch for new code drops, especially around announcements.

Still, Discord codes can be easy to miss, and copying them with the right formatting can be annoying. Bookmark this page and check back often, because we will keep the working list updated and move dead codes into the expired section when they stop working.

What are Clover Origins codes used for?

Clover Origins is the kind of Roblox anime game where your build matters. You are not just collecting rewards for fun. You are using spins and resets to shape the character you actually want to play.

Yen helps with progression, grimoire spins help you chase better magic, race spins let you reroll your race, broom spins help with broom options, trait spins help with character bonuses, and stat resets let you fix mistakes without starting over. That makes these codes useful for both new players and returning players who want to rebuild after an update.

Use the newest codes first, especially the shutdown and bug-fix codes, because those can disappear faster than regular milestone codes.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Brainrot Evolution codes on August 10, 2026

Brainrot Evolution is one of those Roblox games that sounds silly until you actually start playing. You destroy objects, evolve into stranger creatures, collect wins, hatch pets, and keep pushing your brainrot form further.

The grind can feel slow early on, and that is where Brainrot Evolution codes help. These codes give free EXP Potions, Mega EXP Potions, crates, Void Tickets, and other rewards that make it easier to level up and move through the game faster.

Use the codes below exactly as shown. Some Brainrot Evolution codes include spaces, numbers, and mixed capital letters, so copying them is the safest option.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest World Fighters codes, King Legacy Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Brainrot Evolution codes

These Brainrot Evolution codes are no longer working.

PlzSubi2 ,FIXBUG891

How to redeem Brainrot Evolution codes

Redeeming codes in Brainrot Evolution is simple, but the codes menu is inside the shop, so it is easy to miss the first time.

  1. Open Brainrot Evolution in Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Click the Codes button, or scroll until you reach the codes section.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Click Verify to claim your free rewards.

Once the code works, the reward should be added to your account. If you are using EXP Potions or Mega EXP Potions, save them for a proper grinding session so you get the most value from the boost.

Why is my Brainrot Evolution code not working?

Most code issues come down to typos. Brainrot Evolution codes can include capital letters, numbers, and spaces, so even a small mistake can stop the code from working.

If a code fails, try copying and pasting it directly from the list. If it still does not work, the code has likely expired. Roblox game codes can stop working without much warning, especially after updates or events end.

What is Brainrot Evolution?

Brainrot Evolution is a Roblox clicker and evolution game built around chaotic internet humor. You start small, eat or destroy objects, grow stronger, collect wins, hatch pets, and unlock more Brainrot evolutions as you keep playing.

The appeal is simple: it is weird, fast, and built for players who enjoy watching numbers go up while their character turns into something more ridiculous. Codes make that loop smoother by giving you boosts and crates without forcing you to grind from scratch.

How to get more Brainrot Evolution codes

New Brainrot Evolution codes usually arrive through the game’s official community pages. You can check the Brainrot Evolution Discord server, the developer’s X account at @xFrozenStudios, and the official i2Perfect YouTube channel for updates.

You can also bookmark this page. We will keep checking for new Brainrot Evolution codes and update the list when fresh rewards are released.

  • Neo Tennis codes

World Fighters is the kind of Roblox anime game where the fun starts fast, but the grind catches up even faster. You build a team with familiar anime-style heroes, collect stronger fighters, upgrade your setup, and keep pushing for better rewards.

How to redeem World Fighters codes

Redeeming codes in World Fighters is simple, but the code box is not on the main screen. You need to open the shop menu first and scroll to the code section.

  1. Open World Fighters on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the shop menu.
  4. Find the Codes section.
  5. Paste a working code into the Code Here… box.
  6. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

You should redeem the codes one at a time. Copying and pasting is the safest method because many codes use punctuation, capital letters, and special characters.

What are World Fighters codes?

World Fighters codes are free reward codes released by the game’s developer. They usually arrive when the game reaches a milestone, gets an update, hits a player count goal, or receives a certain number of likes, visits, or favorites.

The rewards are built to make the grind easier. Instead of slowly farming everything from scratch, you can use codes to grab gems, potions, Dragon Balls Keys, Saiyan Keys, and special items like the Gadi Jetpack.

That matters because World Fighters is all about building a better anime team. The more resources you have, the easier it becomes to unlock fighters, strengthen your setup, and keep up with harder content.

How to get more World Fighters codes

New World Fighters codes usually appear around updates and community milestones. If the game reaches a new visits goal, likes goal, concurrent player count, or favorites milestone, there is a good chance another code may follow.

The best places to check are the official World Fighters Discord server and the StarX Inc YouTube channel, where the developer shares game-related updates. You can also bookmark this page, because we will keep the list updated when new codes arrive.

Why are my World Fighters codes not Working?

If a World Fighters code is not working, the most common reason is a typing mistake. These codes often include symbols like exclamation marks and question marks, so even one missing character can break the code.

Here are the main things to check:

  • Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code.
  • Copy and paste the code instead of typing it manually.
  • Check that every symbol, number, and capital letter matches.
  • Try again after a server reset if the code is brand new.
  • If the code still fails, it may have expired.

Roblox codes can stop working suddenly, even if they were active earlier. When that happens, the only fix is to wait for the developer to release a new one.

World Fighters codes make the early grind easier

World Fighters is more fun when you are building your dream anime team, not when you are stuck farming the same rewards for hours. These codes give you a strong head start with free potions, gems, keys, and special items.

Redeem every active code while it still works, then check back whenever the game gets a new update or hits another milestone. In a game built around collecting and upgrading, free rewards can save a lot of time.

title.rendered: Be a Brainrot codes (September 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Be a Brainrot Codes on September 03, 2026

Be a Brainrot takes the familiar Roblox brainrot formula and flips it. Instead of chasing brainrots, you are the brainrot. You sneak into enemy bases, grab one of theirs, and rush back before getting caught. The faster you move, the more you steal, and the quicker your base scales.

That is where codes come in. They give you instant cash, which directly translates into speed upgrades and stronger brainrots. If you use them early, progression feels much smoother.

All Working Be a Brainrot codes

  • BRAINROT: 5000 Cash (NEW)
  • RELEASE: 10000 Cash (NEW)

These codes are currently active and verified. Use them as soon as possible since they can expire without warning.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Black Grimoire Code, Hunt Giant Fish Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Be a Brainrot codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Be a Brainrot codes

Redeeming codes only takes a few seconds, and you should do it as soon as you load into the game.

  1. Open Be a Brainrot on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon in the top right corner.
  3. Find the “Enter code” box.
  4. Paste a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Press Enter to claim your reward.

Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code. Even a small mistake will cause it to fail.

Why codes matter in Be a Brainrot

Cash is the core resource in the game. Everything you care about depends on it.

  • Faster speed lets you steal and escape more efficiently
  • Stronger brainrots improve your overall runs
  • Base upgrades increase long-term earnings
  • Offline brainrots generate more cash with upgrades

Using codes early gives you a noticeable advantage. You move faster, scale quicker, and spend less time grinding basic upgrades.

How to get more Be a Brainrot codes

New codes do not follow a fixed schedule, so finding them manually can be frustrating.

The best approach is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. New codes are added as soon as they drop, so you do not miss free rewards.

If you prefer checking yourself, keep an eye on:

  • The official Discord server
  • The Roblox group “Steal a garden or something”

Developers usually release codes during updates, events, or milestones.

Why are your Be a Brainrot codes not working

If a code does not work, there are only a few possible reasons:

  • You typed it incorrectly
  • You added extra spaces
  • The code has expired

The easiest fix is to copy and paste the code directly. If it still fails, it is likely no longer active.

Keep this page bookmarked

Codes in Be a Brainrot do not last forever, and missing even one can slow down your progress. Bookmark this page and check back often. New codes are added as soon as they are released, so you always stay ahead.

In case you missed

  • Clover Origins codes
  • Brainrot Evolution codes
  • King Legacy codes
